description: This file contains a set of unit tests for Orleans' code-generated serializers, verifying their correctness across various data types, object graphs, records, inheritance hierarchies, and external types. It uses the Xunit testing framework to ensure the serializers' properties such as reference preservation, schema evolution support, and type handling.

classes.name: GeneratedSerializerTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies various serialization scenarios in Orleans using generated serializers, including handling of reference preservation, complex types, collections, inheritance, records, external types, and versioning.

classes.name: RecursiveClass
classes.description: A class used in tests for circular references and recursive serialization support.

classes.description: A record or class with explicit constructor, used in serialization of types with primary constructors.

classes.name: Person2ExternalStruct
classes.description: A struct representing an external person type, tested for serialization with external models.

classes.description: A class representing an external person type with support for external serializers.

classes.description: A class with large collections and URI field, tested for handling large and complex data types.
